visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a small orange plush octopus toy with a grumpy facial expression in front of a Shiba Inu dog (Nana) in a home setting. The dog sits attentively on a grey mat, looking up at the toy. The lighting is bright and natural indoor light. (2) The person throws the octopus toy towards the hallway. The Shiba Inu immediately chases after it, its tail wagging. The camera follows the dog's movement as it runs down the white tiled corridor. (3) The dog returns with the orange toy in its mouth. The person reaches down to take it back. (4) The person then presents a larger, fuzzy orange dinosaur toy to the dog. The dog sniffs it briefly but looks away with a neutral expression, showing less interest. (5) A long, grey and green snake-shaped plush toy is shown to the dog. The dog sniffs it but quickly turns its head away as if uninterested, even when the toy is moved near its face. (6) The person brings the orange octopus toy back into view. The Shiba Inu becomes visibly excited, jumping and wagging its tail vigorously. When thrown, the dog dashes after it again. (7) The video concludes with a black and white still image showing a pile of various plush toys, including a large green dinosaur and a teddy bear, representing the 'unloved' old toys.

(2) A 'ding' SFX marks the start of the person counting '1, 2, 3!'. A 'whoosh' SFX signifies a toy being thrown, followed by the soft percussive sound of dog paws running on tiles. (3) The male voice continues in a friendly, conversational tone. A 'bubble' SFX triggers as the dog interacts with the person. (4) As different toys are presented, 'cartoon' style SFX (like a slide whistle or a funny spring sound) emphasize the dog's lack of interest. The BGM remains steady and happy. (5) The male voice laughs and expresses excitement as the dog reacts strongly to the octopus toy. Frequent small 'pop' SFX accompany the text overlays. (6) The video abruptly shifts audio textures. The upbeat music cuts to a melancholic, slow piano melody with high reverb, creating a sad atmosphere to match the black and white image of old toys.
